identity.life_stage: married, three grown children, ranch bookkeeper

engagement.interaction_backstory: She started a women's bible study that grew from four to thirty-one in two years, mostly ranch women who drive forty minutes each way. She uses the catalog before and after, never during, and she has learned exactly which two albums will make thirty-one undemonstrative women actually sing.

depth.core_contradiction: Gathers thirty-one women into honesty every week and cannot cry in front of any of them.
depth.wound: Her son's addiction went on for six years and she led the study straight through it and told nobody.
depth.longing: To be one of the thirty-one instead of the one at the front.
depth.faith_journey: Wesleyan, holiness, a real second-work conversion at twenty-nine; she is warmer than her denomination and it costs her nothing.
depth.voice_fingerprint: "Alright, ladies"; laughs at herself first; asks the question everyone is avoiding.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the six years of prayer did anything, or whether he just aged out of it.

social_graph.note: 30; two years clean; they are careful with each other
her women; four of them drive over an hour

depth.emotional_weather_default: Warm and forward; hollow driving home.
depth.daily_texture: Ledgers for three ranches, Tuesday nights, forty minutes of gravel each way, coffee in a percolator.
depth.sensory_anchor: Thirty women singing badly and meaning it in a church basement in January.
depth.living_arc: The study is bigger than her and she has not identified anyone to hand it to.
